tests.report:
Feature: Completing the setup in one frontend completes it in all frontends
Expected: In both tabs the calibration dialog is gone and the Start button is enabled
Observed failure: I opened the app in tab 1 and again in tab 2. Both showed the dialog "Ersteinrichtung: Bahnen kalibrieren" with Start disabled. In tab 2 I clicked "Bahn 2 steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt" and waited 20 seconds. The fresh snapshot of tab 2 (step 5) still showed the calibration dialog with "Bahn 2 wird kalibriert ..." and "Bitte warten ...", and Start was still disabled. So tab 2 had not met the expected result when the steps say to read it. When I switched to tab 1 without reloading (step 7), its dialog was gone and Start was enabled. That means the result did reach the other frontend. I went back to tab 2 a few seconds later and its dialog was gone and Start was enabled there too. Completion does spread to every frontend, but calibration took longer than the 20-second wait in the steps, so tab 2 failed the check at step 5.
Steps completed before failure: 4

Feature: Stops are driven in a loop
Expected: 'Bahn 1' is seen at stop A, later at stop B and later again at stop A (a detour to the calibration point in between is allowed); it does not stay at stop B
Observed failure: Setup worked. I stopped the running trains, reset all routes, and gave Bahn 1 two stops: A = Haltestelle 1, B = Haltestelle 2. Bahn 2 got the same two stops automatically, so nothing needed changing. Then I clicked Start. The route did not stay on one stop, but Bahn 1 was never seen stopped at B. Location lines from the track graphic:
- Right after Start: "Bahn 1: Kalibrierpunkt – fährt zu Haltestelle 1".
- About 4 s after Start: "Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2 – fährt zu Haltestelle 1". Its target was still A, so it was only passing B. This screenshot fired before the first 25 s wait had finished.
- After the first 25 s wait: "Bahn 1: Kalibrier-Wartepunkt – wartet (Ziel: Haltestelle 2)". Bahn 2 was holding at Haltestelle 2 at that time.
- 25 s later: "Bahn 1: Strecke – fährt zu Kalibrierpunkt".
- 25 s later: "Bahn 1: Haltestelle 1 – hält an Haltestelle 1", so it was at A.
- 25 s later: "Bahn 1: Strecke – wartet (Ziel: Haltestelle 1)". Its target was A again, right after it had held at A.
So Bahn 1 never reached or held at B in any snapshot. It went to the calibration point instead of B, returned to A, and then targeted A again instead of moving on to B. The A → B → A loop was never observed for Bahn 1.
Steps completed before failure: 13
